name: @gravito/pulse
description: The official CLI for Gravito Galaxy Architecture. Scaffold projects and manage your universe.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --external giget --external cac --external @clack/prompts --external picocolors
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --timeout=10000 --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir coverage && bun run --bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.test:ci: bun test --timeout=10000 --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir coverage && bun run --bun scripts/check-coverage.ts

author: Carl Lee <carllee0520@gmail.com>
